title: Production storage soak and VACUUM
scope: storage checkpoint, compaction/VACUUM-equivalent, crash recovery, and benchmark soak coverage

summary: Added a storage soak runner that cycles insert/update/delete workload with checkpoint, compact, graceful restart, forced-kill recovery, visibility checks, indexed bucket checks, and SSTable guards.
Fixed reopened FusionStorage MemTable ID allocation to avoid overwriting existing SSTables after restart.
Fixed current_ts recovery by scanning loaded SSTable keys.
Fixed point reads to choose the latest visible MVCC timestamp across SSTables after compaction creates a high-ID output file.
Fixed immutable MemTable range scans to use SkipMap as the correctness source instead of the optional FBTree read index.
Fixed compaction reader safety by serializing compaction, deferring obsolete SSTable file deletion until readers release old handles, and propagating SSTable iterator read errors.
